Projections `s.i` are reduced at `whnfCore`, and `whnf` is used at `s` during the process.

/--
  Projections `s.i` are reduced at `whnfCore`, and `whnf` is used at `s` during the process.
  Recall that `whnfCore` does not perform `delta` reduction (i.e., it will not unfold constant declarations), but `whnf` does.
  -/
  | yesWithDelta
